independent_solve.reasoning: A charge at the face center of a cube is shared equally by 2 adjacent cubes, so the fraction inside the cube is 1/2. Thus, flux from charge q/2 is Φ₁ = (1/2)(q/2)/ε₀ = q/(4ε₀). A charge at a corner is shared by 8 adjacent cubes, so the fraction inside the cube is 1/8. Thus, flux from charge 2q is Φ₂ = (1/8)(2q)/ε₀ = q/(4ε₀). The total electric flux through the cube is Φ = Φ₁ + Φ₂ = q/(4ε₀) + q/(4ε₀) = q/(2ε₀). Comparing with (nq)/(2ε₀), we get n = 1.
